name: nucleotide
title: Nucleotide
description: DNA and RNA bases as tonal tiles and strands: Nelumbo, base-pair and purine/pyrimidine schemes plus IGV, Jalview, trace and Okabe-Ito redrawn at one lightness; complement strand, codon footers, inline or top rulers, selection; NucleotideChange for mutations (changed bases as a capsule, indels aligned with gaps); complement, translate and GC helpers.
